description: Reviewed rules with their conditions, provenance and remaining limits.

detail.scope: Selected reviewed rules, with their original authority, conditions and limits. This is not an exhaustive mechanics guide.

name: Settlements & capitals

rule_views.conditions: Developer confirmation relayed by the user on 17 September 2026.
rule_views.limits: Original developer message was not independently inspected. No construction test. This statement does not establish what happens to fields above the former-capital cap.
rule_views.statement: Building a Palace in another village automatically moves the capital, without a separate confirmation.
rule_views.title: Moving the capital by building a Palace

rule_views.conditions: Building description in the supplied in-game screenshot.
rule_views.limits: The description alone does not establish the click sequence or automatic capital transfer; that has separate developer testimony.
rule_views.statement: A village with a Palace cannot be conquered. Levels 10, 15 and 20 unlock expansion slots for settlers or a chief. The Palace allows the village to become the capital.
rule_views.title: Palace protection and expansion slots
